purpose: Acquire a small, independent set of local neuronal SAME_PROCESS and DIFFERENT_PROCESS decisions for target-domain affinity supervision. This request is not whole-neuron tracing and does not authorize biological reconstruction.

raw_data_handling.delivery: Reviewer must receive legitimate access to the local project data or separately authorized source access. Do not export or upload raw EM until source terms explicitly permit that route.

protected_regions.MV-GTVOL-000004: REGRESSION_ONLY; prohibited from review, question generation, training, validation, or calibration

required_decision_schema.geometry: A and B must be an adjacent, axis-aligned Z/Y/X voxel pair. Record the left voxel as pair_left_zyx and channel_zyx as 0=Z, 1=Y, 2=X.
required_decision_schema.minimum_evidence: Raw EM in XY, XZ, YZ, and neighbouring Z slices. Machine overlays may be consulted only after the raw-EM judgement and must be recorded as optional diagnostics.
required_decision_schema.uncertainty: UNCERTAIN and BAD_QUESTION are excluded from loss; neither may be coerced into SAME or DIFFERENT.

downstream_state: G1 remains BLOCKED_PENDING_REVIEWED_DVID_BOUNDARY_EVIDENCE. No MV-FRAG, MV-N, MV-SYN, or MV-CONN may be created from this request.
